note: Thekas vary by teacher and gharana: confirm these with your teacher and edit here. Signs: X = sam, 2/3/4 = taali (clap), 0 = khali (wave). A '-' bol is a rest or extension of the previous bol; the matra is still counted.

taals.name: Teentaal
taals.note: Matras 12-13 are also written Na Na or Ta Na; the khali vibhag is played with the right hand only.
taals.source: Wikipedia (Teental); chandrakantha.com; UW Gangolli theka list

taals.name: Ektaal
taals.note: Bols vary by teacher: some write Kat Tin at 7-8, Tu as Tun, and Tirakita as Traka at speed. The usual slow (vilambit) khayal taal.
taals.source: Wikipedia (Ektal); chandrakantha.com; ancient-future.com; UW Gangolli theka list

taals.name: Jhaptaal
taals.note: Also spelled Dhi Na | Dhi Dhi Na | Ti Na | Dhi Dhi Na.
taals.source: Wikipedia (Jhaptal); chandrakantha.com; UW Gangolli theka list

taals.name: Rupak
taals.note: Matra 1 is the sam AND a wave (khali), so it is shown as 0 and plays the khali sound. Some books print X there instead.
taals.source: chandrakantha.com; UW Gangolli theka list; Wikipedia (Rupak tala)

taals.name: Dadra
taals.note: Variants: Dha Dhi Na | Dha Tu Na; Dha Dhin Na | Ta Tin Na. Not played slow (vilambit).
taals.source: chandrakantha.com; Wikipedia (Dadra); Sahapedia; UW Gangolli theka list

taals.name: Keherwa
taals.note: Matra 7 is also written Dhi. Countless variants (Bhajani, Dhumali) exist. Not played slow (vilambit).

taals.name: Chautaal
taals.note: Shown in the 2+2+2+2+2+2 form with waves at 3 and 7. A second school divides it 4+4+2+2 with claps only at 1, 5, 9, 11 and no khali: if your teacher uses that, set vibhags to [4, 4, 2, 2] and khali to []. Spellings Kite/Tete/Gena also occur. Pakhawaj taal for dhrupad.
taals.source: chandrakantha.com (2x6 and 4+4+2+2 noted); Wikipedia (Vibhag); ancient-future.com; UW Gangolli theka list

taals.name: Deepchandi
taals.note: Also called Chanchar. Matras 3, 7, 10 and 14 are rests ('-'); chandrakantha.com writes Na at 14. There is also a 16-matra form. Used for thumri and hori.
taals.source: chandrakantha.com; UW Gangolli theka list; Sahapedia

taals.name: Tilwada
taals.note: Same clap/wave frame as Teentaal with a different theka. Slow (vilambit) khayal only; it loses its character when sped up.

taals.name: Jhoomra
taals.note: '-Dha' and '-Ta' mean a half-matra rest, then the bol on the second half of the matra. Very slow (ati-vilambit) khayal only.
